title: Literature: Heyde-Mahadevan landscapes restore relative to mean fitness (no forgetting clock), which the vortex wastes lack; Flow-Lenia's embedded parameters pass through fusions by sampling, a route to heredity for c62's fusing predators
summary: Heyde and Mahadevan 2026 deplete each trait point by its own density and restore it relative to the mean fitness, with no fixed decay. c58's and c63's vortex wastes forget on a clock (500-2000 t), which plausibly lets the population cycle back over old ground. That would explain why both mean and distribution memory give bounded clouds. Kisdi et al. 2001 (UNVERIFIED) read bounded Red Queen dynamics as cycles. Plantec et al. 2025 carry Flow-Lenia rule parameters on matter and sample one parameter set at merges rather than averaging; activity grows roughly linearly while the number of distinct parameter sets saturates. Sampling at merges would keep a trait intact through the frequent fusions of c62's predators. Two questions follow.
